purpose: Text-only morphology anchors for near-canonical subject recognition in newly composed, fan-made artwork. These descriptions are not permission to copy an official image or performer likeness.

profileSelection.rule: Choose the narrowest profile that describes the principal subject. Add secondaryProfiles in the brief when another clearly visible subject has independent mandatory anchors.
profileSelection.fallback: A fallback profile is allowed only for genuinely original subjects, never to avoid the anchors of a known creature, faction, object or place.
profileSelection.multiSubject: Every foreground or story-critical subject must have its own profile and complete anchor evaluation.

profiles.label: Standard adult xenomorph

requiredAnchors.label: Elongated eyeless cranial dome
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long rear-projecting cranial dome dominates the head; no ordinary visible eyes or human facial planes.

requiredAnchors.label: Secondary inner jaw
requiredAnchors.requirement: The mouth construction can plausibly house the characteristic telescoping inner jaw; show it directly when the crop permits.

requiredAnchors.label: Biomechanical ribbing
requiredAnchors.requirement: The torso and limbs combine organic exoskeleton, tendon-like channels and ribbed mechanical-looking structures rather than smooth fantasy armor.

requiredAnchors.label: Back structures
requiredAnchors.requirement: Adult dorsal tubes or equivalent profile-correct back structures read clearly and connect anatomically to the upper torso.

requiredAnchors.label: Segmented weapon tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long articulated tail continues from the pelvis and ends in a credible blade or piercing structure, never a mammalian or reptile tail.

requiredAnchors.label: Predatory limb proportions
requiredAnchors.requirement: The tall, lean body has extended limbs, clawed hands and a coherent predatory stance without human costume proportions.

promptDirectives: Make the eyeless elongated dome and tail readable in silhouette.
Preserve coherent biomechanical anatomy at every joint.
Use a new pose, camera and environment unrelated to any identifiable film still.

profiles.label: Xenomorph queen

requiredAnchors.label: Wide transverse cranial crown
requiredAnchors.requirement: A broad, flattened crown extends laterally and rearward, creating a silhouette clearly distinct from a standard adult.

requiredAnchors.label: Elongated head beneath crown
requiredAnchors.requirement: The eyeless elongated primary head remains structurally readable beneath the crown, with jaws aligned to the neck.

requiredAnchors.label: Small secondary arm pair
requiredAnchors.requirement: A smaller secondary pair of arms is visibly and coherently attached to the upper torso in addition to the main arms.

requiredAnchors.label: Towering hind-leg stance
requiredAnchors.requirement: Massive load-bearing legs, elevated torso and long reach establish a matriarch much larger than a standard adult.

requiredAnchors.label: Massive bladed tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long heavy segmented tail with a substantial weaponized terminal blade counterbalances the body.

requiredAnchors.label: Layered biomechanical carapace
requiredAnchors.requirement: Crown, torso and limbs share coherent ribbed exoskeletal surface language rather than ornamental fantasy plating.

forbiddenDrift: insect abdomen replacing the established torso
promptDirectives: Show the full crown width and both arm pairs.
Use scale cues that establish queen stature.
Keep the scene and pose entirely original.

profiles.label: Facehugger

requiredAnchors.label: Central palm-like body
requiredAnchors.requirement: A compact flattened central body houses the organism; it must not read as a spider thorax or humanoid torso.

requiredAnchors.label: Eight grasping digits
requiredAnchors.requirement: Four long articulated digits per side are countable or unambiguously arranged around the central body.

requiredAnchors.label: Long coiling tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A single long muscular prehensile tail extends from the rear and remains distinct from the eight digits.

requiredAnchors.label: Pale tendon-like surface
requiredAnchors.requirement: Surface anatomy reads as pale, fibrous and organic with joints and tendons, not furry, armored or metallic.

promptDirectives: Keep all eight digits anatomically separable.
Make the long tail visible without confusing it with a ninth leg.

profiles.label: Chestburster

requiredAnchors.label: Serpentine hatchling body
requiredAnchors.requirement: A small elongated flexible body reads as an immature organism, not a miniature adult standing upright.

requiredAnchors.label: Immature elongated head
requiredAnchors.requirement: The head already carries the family elongation and prominent jaw construction without ordinary eyes.

requiredAnchors.label: Small coherent forelimbs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Small forelimbs attach coherently near the upper body and are neither full adult arms nor random tentacles.

requiredAnchors.label: Wet immature tissue
requiredAnchors.requirement: The surface reads as newly emerged organic tissue with early ribbing rather than mature plated armor.

promptDirectives: Prioritize immature scale and serpentine movement.
Avoid explicit gore unless the card brief requires it; morphology must remain readable.

profiles.label: Quadrupedal runner variant

requiredAnchors.label: Low quadrupedal line
requiredAnchors.requirement: Spine, shoulder and pelvis form a low fast quadrupedal silhouette designed for sustained four-limb locomotion.

requiredAnchors.label: Xenomorph cranial identity
requiredAnchors.requirement: The eyeless elongated dome and jaw construction remain unmistakably xenomorph despite host-derived proportions.

requiredAnchors.label: Host-adapted running limbs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Fore and hind limbs have coherent load-bearing joints and digit structure; no arbitrary canine head or paws.

requiredAnchors.label: Long balancing tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: The segmented weaponized tail balances the forward-driving runner posture.

promptDirectives: Read as a xenomorph optimized for quadrupedal speed, not a fantasy hound.

profiles.label: Praetorian or heavy hive guard

requiredAnchors.label: Heavy cranial shield
requiredAnchors.requirement: A reinforced head shield expands the baseline dome but remains narrower and less laterally dominant than a queen crown.

requiredAnchors.label: Reinforced body mass
requiredAnchors.requirement: Torso, shoulders and load-bearing limbs are substantially heavier than a drone while preserving xenomorph biomechanical structure.

requiredAnchors.label: Eyeless xenomorph face and jaw
requiredAnchors.requirement: No visible eyes or vertebrate muzzle; the family jaw system remains intact.

requiredAnchors.label: Armored weapon tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long segmented tail with a powerful terminal weapon is fully integrated into the pelvis.

promptDirectives: Balance royal-guard mass with unmistakable xenomorph anatomy.

profiles.label: Armored yautja hunter

requiredAnchors.label: Tall broad humanoid frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: A very tall, broad-shouldered, powerful humanoid has long reach and non-human mass distribution without becoming a generic bodybuilder.

requiredAnchors.label: Mandibular head logic
requiredAnchors.requirement: Even under a mask, jaw width, neck and head volume plausibly accommodate four-part mandibles rather than a human face.

requiredAnchors.label: Thick quill-like locks
requiredAnchors.requirement: Numerous thick dark quill-like locks emerge anatomically from the rear and sides of the head, with beads optional by role.

requiredAnchors.label: Asymmetric layered hunting armor
requiredAnchors.requirement: Armor combines practical plates, mesh or flexible underlayer, trophies and exposed mobility zones; it is not a symmetrical knight suit.

requiredAnchors.label: Profile-specific biomask
requiredAnchors.requirement: When masked, the helmet has a purposeful non-human faceplate, integrated vision system and role-specific geometry without copying an exact official prop.

requiredAnchors.label: Functional hunting loadout
requiredAnchors.requirement: Weapons and tools mount coherently to gauntlets, shoulder, belt or back and respect range of motion.

forbiddenDrift: human face under a decorative helmet
promptDirectives: Design an original clan-specific armor arrangement while preserving species anatomy.
Do not request or reproduce any performer likeness.
Make mask, locks, armor and weapon mounts coherent from one camera angle.

profiles.label: Unmasked yautja

requiredAnchors.label: Four articulated mandibles
requiredAnchors.requirement: Two upper and two lower lateral mandibles form a coherent four-part jaw around the central mouth; their hinges and closure path are plausible.

requiredAnchors.label: Central inner mouth
requiredAnchors.requirement: A central mouth sits inside the opened mandibles with non-human dental structure and no ordinary human lips.

requiredAnchors.label: Deep-set non-performer eyes
requiredAnchors.requirement: Small deep-set eyes sit above the mandibles in an original non-human face that resembles no real performer.

requiredAnchors.label: Quill-lock crown
requiredAnchors.requirement: Thick quill-like locks originate across the rear and sides of the skull and retain believable weight and attachment.

requiredAnchors.label: Mottled leathery skin
requiredAnchors.requirement: Skin reads as thick, leathery and variably mottled, not mammalian fur, smooth human skin or reptile scales pasted onto a human face.

promptDirectives: Explicitly count and articulate four mandibles.
Build a wholly original non-performer face.

profiles.label: Yautja hunting hound

requiredAnchors.label: Powerful quadrupedal hunter
requiredAnchors.requirement: A coherent muscular quadruped has a low pursuit posture, load-bearing limbs and a non-domestic silhouette.

requiredAnchors.label: Distinctive cranial and dorsal spines
requiredAnchors.requirement: Profile-defining spines or quills emerge from anatomically credible plates rather than floating or decorative placement.

requiredAnchors.label: Alien predatory jaw
requiredAnchors.requirement: The head and jaw remain alien and functional, not a recognizable Earth dog breed with added armor.

requiredAnchors.label: Leathery hide and natural plate
requiredAnchors.requirement: Surface transitions between tough hide and natural armor with no synthetic pet gear unless specified by the brief.

promptDirectives: Keep the creature distinct from both an Earth canine and a xenomorph.

profiles.label: Engineer humanoid

requiredAnchors.label: Monumental humanlike scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: A tall, powerfully proportioned humanoid reads as related to humanity but physically monumental and unnervingly idealized.

requiredAnchors.label: Hairless pale head
requiredAnchors.requirement: The head is hairless, pale and sculptural with an elongated cranial volume; it must not reproduce a specific performer's face.

requiredAnchors.label: Deep dark eyes
requiredAnchors.requirement: Deep-set dark eyes and restrained non-human facial proportions create the correct species read without actor likeness.

requiredAnchors.label: Sculptural musculature
requiredAnchors.requirement: Body structure is dense and anatomical, with smooth monumental forms rather than a grey alien or ordinary bodybuilder.

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated biomechanical suit
requiredAnchors.requirement: When suited, ribbed pressure architecture integrates with neck, torso and limbs as engineered life-support, not generic armor.

promptDirectives: Use an original face built from species-level written traits only.
Keep the figure monumental through proportion and environmental scale cues.

profiles.label: Xenomorph-yautja hybrid

requiredAnchors.label: Dominant xenomorph body plan
requiredAnchors.requirement: The creature remains fundamentally xenomorph in torso, limbs, eyeless head and tail, not a yautja wearing organic armor.

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated yautja-derived mandibles
requiredAnchors.requirement: Four-part mandible influence is integrated into the outer jaw while preserving the xenomorph inner-jaw system.

requiredAnchors.label: Host-derived cranial quills
requiredAnchors.requirement: Thick quill-like appendages emerge organically behind the elongated cranium without becoming human hair.

requiredAnchors.label: Heavy hybrid mass
requiredAnchors.requirement: Shoulders, neck and limbs carry greater host-derived mass while retaining biomechanical ribbing and predatory articulation.

requiredAnchors.label: Xenomorph weapon tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long segmented bladed tail remains fully present and anatomically connected.

promptDirectives: Blend host-derived mandibles and quills into a dominant xenomorph anatomy; do not split the design into costume parts.

profiles.label: Pale neomorphic organism

requiredAnchors.label: Pale translucent tissue
requiredAnchors.requirement: A pale, wet, faintly translucent body has taut organic tissue rather than black biomechanical plating.

requiredAnchors.label: Smooth pointed cranium
requiredAnchors.requirement: The eyeless head is smooth and slopes into a pointed rear profile distinct from the long tubular standard xenomorph dome.

requiredAnchors.label: Wide predatory mouth
requiredAnchors.requirement: A wide mouth opens through the lower face with needle-like teeth and coherent jaw tissue, without yautja mandibles.

requiredAnchors.label: Lean digitigrade limbs
requiredAnchors.requirement: Long lean limbs support explosive quadrupedal or bipedal motion with coherent elongated digits.

requiredAnchors.label: Long tapering tail
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long organic tapering tail balances the body and remains visually distinct from the heavier segmented xenomorph tail.

promptDirectives: Keep the pale organic variant visually distinct from the black biomechanical xenomorph family.

profiles.label: Deacon-like engineer-derived organism

requiredAnchors.label: Blue-grey organic tissue
requiredAnchors.requirement: Dense blue-grey organic skin distinguishes the organism from black plated xenomorph and pale neomorph surfaces.

requiredAnchors.label: Tall pointed cranium
requiredAnchors.requirement: The cranium rises and tapers rearward into a tall pointed profile rather than a long horizontal dome.

requiredAnchors.label: Protrusible toothed jaw
requiredAnchors.requirement: The mouth and jaw can thrust forward with a coherent ring of predatory teeth, while remaining distinct from a standard inner jaw.

requiredAnchors.label: Newborn humanoid-xenoid plan
requiredAnchors.requirement: The body is a tall emerging biped with elongated limbs and coherent immature proportions, not a standard adult xenomorph recolor.

promptDirectives: Preserve the vertical pointed cranium and engineer-derived body read.

profiles.label: Black pathogen mutant

requiredAnchors.label: Recognizable host body plan
requiredAnchors.requirement: The original host species remains readable in skeletal plan and scale beneath the mutation.

requiredAnchors.label: Directional anatomical mutation
requiredAnchors.requirement: Elongation, tissue tension, pigmentation and joint change follow a coherent biological progression rather than random extra parts.

requiredAnchors.label: Dark vascular contamination
requiredAnchors.requirement: Dark vascular or fluid-like contamination travels through tissue with plausible origin and flow; it is not decorative paint.

requiredAnchors.label: Predatory transition
requiredAnchors.requirement: Posture, hands, jaw or limbs visibly transition toward a dangerous organism while retaining host-derived evidence.

promptDirectives: Make the mutation biologically directional and rooted in an original host face/body.

profiles.label: Large pale trilobite organism

requiredAnchors.label: Large central disc body
requiredAnchors.requirement: A broad pale central body anchors all appendages and reads as a single organism rather than a pile of tentacles.

requiredAnchors.label: Multiple muscular grasping arms
requiredAnchors.requirement: Long thick arms radiate with distinct roots and coherent joints or flex zones, suited to restraining a much larger host.

requiredAnchors.label: Central parasitic orifice
requiredAnchors.requirement: The underside or center contains a coherent feeding or implantation opening tied to the body structure.

requiredAnchors.label: Pale wet membrane
requiredAnchors.requirement: Surface is pale, wet and muscular with translucent membrane, not cephalopod camouflage or armored shell.

promptDirectives: Use human or architecture scale cues to show that this is much larger than a facehugger.

profiles.label: Hammerpede

requiredAnchors.label: Pale serpentine body
requiredAnchors.requirement: A limbless flexible pale body coils and rears with coherent musculature and scale.

requiredAnchors.label: Flared hammer-shaped head
requiredAnchors.requirement: The head broadens laterally into a distinctive hammer or hood profile with a central mouth construction.

requiredAnchors.label: No ordinary snake eyes
requiredAnchors.requirement: The cranial surface avoids ordinary snake eyes and establishes alien sensory anatomy.

requiredAnchors.label: Slick organic skin
requiredAnchors.requirement: Wet pale skin has subtle vascular and tendon detail rather than scales, fur or biomechanical armor.

promptDirectives: Make the laterally flared head readable from the chosen angle.

profiles.label: Original human character

requiredAnchors.label: Original non-performer face
requiredAnchors.requirement: Facial geometry, hair, age cues and expression form a new person who does not resemble a franchise performer or public figure.

requiredAnchors.label: Correct human anatomy
requiredAnchors.requirement: Hands, face, limbs and joints are natural, countable and free of generation artifacts.

requiredAnchors.label: Role-readable silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: Clothing, posture and carried tools communicate the role before fine detail, without recreating an identifiable costume exactly.

requiredAnchors.label: Functional original wardrobe
requiredAnchors.requirement: Clothing and gear share a practical industrial language, fit the body and permit movement; insignia and branding are original.

requiredAnchors.label: Believable scale context
requiredAnchors.requirement: Body, equipment and environment use consistent real-world scale and perspective.

promptDirectives: State explicitly that the person and face are original and not based on an actor.
Design role-specific clothing rather than reproducing a screen costume.

profiles.label: Faction equipment, weapon or vehicle

requiredAnchors.label: Recognizable function
requiredAnchors.requirement: Grip, trigger, controls, optics, hinges, apertures, joints or access points explain how the object is used.

requiredAnchors.label: Profile-correct silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: The outer shape and mass distribution match the named object class and faction logic without becoming a generic prop.

requiredAnchors.label: Coherent construction
requiredAnchors.requirement: Parts connect, articulate and bear loads plausibly; repeated details remain consistent and no component melts into another.

requiredAnchors.label: Faction material language
requiredAnchors.requirement: Materials, wear, manufacturing and energy cues consistently express human industrial, yautja hunting or engineer biomechanical origin.

requiredAnchors.label: Original detailed design
requiredAnchors.requirement: The design preserves recognizable fictional function through written traits but does not duplicate an official prop, blueprint, logo or product shot.

requiredAnchors.label: Correct operational scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: Hands, mounts, body, room or known interfaces establish plausible size and use.

promptDirectives: Describe operating logic and attachment points, not only appearance.
Create an original product silhouette and camera angle.

profiles.label: Harness-supported colonial smartgun system

requiredAnchors.label: Articulated support arm
requiredAnchors.requirement: The long weapon connects to a body-worn load harness through a multi-jointed stabilizing arm whose pivots clear the operator and carry its weight.

requiredAnchors.label: Two-hand control geometry
requiredAnchors.requirement: Two distinct hand controls, trigger logic and forearm clearance create a credible firing grip without fused fingers or a shoulder-rifle stock.

requiredAnchors.label: Integrated tracking assembly
requiredAnchors.requirement: A compact sensor and aiming assembly aligns with barrel, receiver and harness cabling instead of floating as decorative optics.

requiredAnchors.label: Harnessed heavy-barrel silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: A long vented barrel and substantial receiver read as a stabilized squad support weapon, not an assault rifle, rotary minigun or shoulder cannon.

promptDirectives: Show the complete load path from barrel through articulated arm to the original body harness.

profiles.label: Open industrial power-loader frame

requiredAnchors.label: Open operator cage
requiredAnchors.requirement: A visible human operator stands inside an open protective frame with limbs aligned to controls; the machine must not become a sealed robot or powered armor suit.

requiredAnchors.label: Bilateral hydraulic lifting arms
requiredAnchors.requirement: Two large articulated arms use visible pivots, cylinders and paired clamp manipulators with coherent reach and no duplicated joints.

requiredAnchors.label: Load-bearing leg frame
requiredAnchors.requirement: Wide mechanical legs, braced ankles and stable industrial feet transfer lifting forces to the floor around—not through—the operator's body.

requiredAnchors.label: Visible hydraulic logic
requiredAnchors.requirement: Hoses, cylinders, guards and counterweights connect to the joints they actuate and remain readable under the chosen pose.

promptDirectives: Keep the operator, open cage, two clamp arms and load-bearing leg frame visible together in an original industrial configuration.

profiles.label: Biomechanical hive or ancient interior

requiredAnchors.label: Biological-structural continuity
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ribs, conduits, vaults, membranes and load-bearing forms grow into one another with a consistent structural grammar.

requiredAnchors.label: Navigable architectural scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: Floor, thresholds, chambers, passages and scale cues make the space usable rather than an abstract texture field.

requiredAnchors.label: Readable depth and route
requiredAnchors.requirement: Foreground, middle ground and destination establish depth, navigation and a clear gameplay focal path.

requiredAnchors.label: Original layout
requiredAnchors.requirement: Architecture, camera and lighting are independently composed and do not reconstruct an identifiable official set or still.

requiredAnchors.label: Coherent detail hierarchy
requiredAnchors.requirement: Large structure leads medium ribbing and fine surface detail; random pipes and spikes do not erase the place's function.

promptDirectives: Invent a new floor plan and camera position.
Use structural hierarchy and scale cues before surface ornament.

profiles.label: Human industrial frontier environment

requiredAnchors.label: Functional industrial architecture
requiredAnchors.requirement: Doors, decks, ladders, rails, work zones and machinery support a clear human purpose and traffic flow.

requiredAnchors.label: Modular frontier language
requiredAnchors.requirement: Robust modular construction, exposed services and repairable panels create a practical frontier-future identity.

requiredAnchors.label: Human scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: Ceilings, controls, seats, doors and tools are dimensionally consistent with people and vehicles.

requiredAnchors.label: Original layout and camera
requiredAnchors.requirement: The floor plan, prop arrangement, weather, light and view are original rather than a recreation of an official set or frame.

requiredAnchors.label: Gameplay-readable route
requiredAnchors.requirement: The image has a clear focal zone, route, threat line or defensible geometry suitable for the represented game state.

promptDirectives: Describe the site's job, circulation and wear history.
Use original signage symbols or no signage; never reproduce official branding.

profiles.label: Original multi-subject key art or battle scene

requiredAnchors.label: All key subjects profiled
requiredAnchors.requirement: Every foreground or story-critical creature, person, object and location names a secondary profile and passes all of its anchors.

requiredAnchors.label: Original composition
requiredAnchors.requirement: Camera, poses, grouping, action beat, environment and lighting form a new composition unrelated to any identifiable official image.

requiredAnchors.label: Clear visual hierarchy
requiredAnchors.requirement: A primary subject, secondary action and environment remain readable at target display size without a collage effect.

requiredAnchors.label: Consistent inter-subject scale
requiredAnchors.requirement: People, creatures, equipment and architecture share coherent perspective, contact shadows and relative size.

requiredAnchors.label: No identity merge
requiredAnchors.requirement: Silhouettes and anatomy remain separable; limbs, weapons, tails and armor do not merge between subjects.

promptDirectives: List every key subject profile before generation.
Design a new action beat and camera blocking from scratch.

profiles.label: Genuinely original unclassified subject

requiredAnchors.label: Brief-defined silhouette
requiredAnchors.requirement: The brief specifies a unique outer shape and the result follows it consistently.

requiredAnchors.label: Coherent anatomy or construction
requiredAnchors.requirement: Every visible part has a plausible attachment, function and repeated design logic.

requiredAnchors.label: Distinct signature traits
requiredAnchors.requirement: At least three independently authored identifying traits are visible and verified.

requiredAnchors.label: Not a fallback for known canon
requiredAnchors.requirement: The subject is genuinely new and is not using this profile to evade a more specific known-family profile.

requiredAnchors.label: Rights-safe original design
requiredAnchors.requirement: No official image input, protected asset, actor likeness, logo or copied composition contributes to the design.

promptDirectives: Record why no narrower profile applies.
Define at least three novel signature traits before generation.
